result: For every integer s>=2, the exact universal marked regular presentation U_s is an actual regular hypertope group with prescribed ordered toroidal locals and U_s=P_s semidirect C2. It has finite regular quotients retaining all locals. It is infinite whenever6 divides s; no further universal orders asserted.
proof_mechanism: Exact finite tensor examples attain all four finite local torus upper bounds; small cases2/3 are retained.
Every maximal universal parabolic therefore injects into the finite quotient; fullIP and typedHelly lift by the all-maximal quotient theorem.
Both types of triangular torus lattice, (a,0) and (a,a), are reflection-invariant. This proves invariant even normal closure and the literal rotational semidirect product, for all parities.
U_s maps onto the certified infinite U6 when6 divides s.
source_quantifier_scope: Finite-existence reading of Problem9.2 answered by all-parameter constructions. Source printedp19 asks an infinite family at integer s>=2; precedingp18 supplies finite context and Table8 has universal examples. Universal finiteness for all parameters is false; no novelty claim.
priority_status: Unverified; full 2024 Abelian covers paper remains an unread comparison lead.
scope_exclusions: No universal-finiteness claim for all s
